name: When should I consider hydro jetting instead of snaking for my clogged drains?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider hydro jetting instead of snaking for my clogged drains?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider hydro jetting when you have persistent or severe drain clogs, slow drains, or recurring issues that traditional snaking can't resolve. Snaking often only creates a small path through a blockage, while hydro jetting completely scours the pipe walls clean. For instance, if you have frequent clogs due to grease buildup in a kitchen drain or tree root intrusion in an outdoor line, hydro jetting offers a more lasting solution. Choosing between the two often depends on the nature and location of the clog, and a professional assessment from CG Plumbing Solutions can help determine the most effective approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Opt for hydro jetting over snaking for persistent or severe clogs, especially those caused by grease, roots, or recurring issues, as it offers a more thorough cleaning.
